notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 2501, added Pub. L. 100–456, div. A, title VIII, § 821(b)(1)(B), Sept. 29, 1988, 102 Stat. 2014, related to centralized guidance, analysis, and planning, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 102–484, § 4202(a). Another prior section 2501 was renumbered section 4861 of this title.
